header.running_head: Statements of the Sahabah (RA) Concerning Their Qualities

blocks.text: would have used the word (meaning "You are"), in which case the verse would have referred to all of us (whether a person enjoins good and forbids evil or not). However, Allaah used the word (meaning "you were") to refer specifically to the Sahabah (RA). Therefore, whoever does as the Sahabah (RA) did (enjoins good and forbids evil) shall be among "the best of all nations who have been raised for (the benefit and salvation of) mankind." [^1]
Hadhrat Qataadah (RAH) reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once recited the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَتُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ
blocks.text: "You were the best of all nations who have been raised for (the benefit and salvation of) mankind. You enjoin good and forbid evil and have Imaan in Allaah."

Thereafter, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "O people! Whoever wishes to be among this Ummah (who are the best of nations), then he should fulfil the condition that Allaah mentions in the verse (i.e. enjoin good and forbid evil)." [^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) stated, "Allaah looked at the hearts of all His servants and chose that of Muhammad ﷺ. Allaah then made him His messenger and granted him special knowledge from His own. Allaah then again gazed at the hearts of His servants and selected companions for Rasulullaah ﷺ (the Sahabah (RA)) to assist (in the propagation of) His Deen and to be assistants in bearing the responsibility of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Therefore, whatever these Mu'mineen (the Sahabah (RA)) regard as good, is good in the eyes of Allaah and whatever they regard as unacceptable, is unacceptable in the eyes of Allaah." [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) had mentioned, "Whoever wishes to follow the ways of another, should follow the ways of those who have passed away. These were the companions of Muhammad ﷺ, who were the best people of this Ummah. Their hearts were most pious, their knowledge was deepest and they were least pretentious. They were people whom Allaah had chosen to be companions of His Nabi ﷺ and for the transmission of His Deen. You people should therefore emulate their character and mannerisms. By the Rabb of the Kabah! The Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ were correctly guided."[^4]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) once said to the people, "Although you people fast more often, perform more salaah and make more effort, the companions of Rasulullaah ﷺ were better than you." When the people asked him the reason for this, he replied, "Because they had less concern for this
